card.name: All-caps words before 'of', 'with', 'on'
card.fires_on: The last piece of a noun in ALL-CAPS warning text, such as PATIENT(S) or VOMIT(ING), where a preposition like OF, WITH or ON comes next.

modes.label: Patients in caps

modes.label: Other capitalised nouns
modes.description: The ending of other capitalised nouns or words, like VOMITING or AGE, before a linking word.

card.writes: It pushes capitalised linking words such as Of, With, On and From next, and suppresses lowercase ones.
card.plain: In all-capital label text, it fires on a noun's ending when a small linking word like OF or WITH should follow.
